next_delta_read.en: With others responding, a comparison whose responses the dynamics give; how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the influence closure reads a formation's own feedback.

next_delta.zh: 他者有回应时，不另给“其余只经其识回应”这一前提、由动力学给出回应的比较（在该前提下，P65 把比较定在回应所及之内，见 comparison-where-the-rest-responds）；到达回应所及之内的差别有多少；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：影响闭包是否读出形成自身的反馈。
next_delta.en: With others responding, a comparison whose responses the dynamics give without supplying that the rest responds only through its registration (under that premise P65 decides the comparison within the responsive reach, comparison-where-the-rest-responds); how much difference arrives within the responsive reach; how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the influence closure reads a formation's own feedback.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P65：其余经其识回应时，比较在部分的回应所及之内决定，即部分对影响所识者的闭包；只识支持、只有一个流时，回应所及就是成员所及闭包的并（Becoming.Response，comparison-where-the-rest-responds）。回应的前提是另给的，所以开放项只部分回答；next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_RESPONSE}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P65: with the rest responding through its registration, the comparison is decided within the part's responsive reach, its closure under affecting what is registered; registering support only, with one flow, the responsive reach is the union of the members' reach closures (Becoming.Response, comparison-where-the-rest-responds). The response premise is supplied, so the open item is answered in part; next_delta revised; see §{S_RESPONSE} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

next_delta_read.zh: 动力学给出回应的比较；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：较弱版本是否读作覆盖中心所及的意义。

next_delta.zh: 不另给“其余只经其识回应”这一前提、由动力学给出回应的比较（在该前提下，P65 把比较定在回应所及之内，见 comparison-where-the-rest-responds）；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：较弱版本是否读作覆盖中心所及的意义。
next_delta.en: A comparison whose responses the dynamics give without supplying that the rest responds only through its registration (under that premise P65 decides it within the responsive reach, comparison-where-the-rest-responds); how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the weaker version reads as significance covering what a center reaches.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P65：本记录的比较保持其余固定；其余经其识回应时，比较在部分的回应所及之内决定，回应所及包含部分所及（Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response，comparison-where-the-rest-responds）。回应的前提是另给的；next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_RESPONSE}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P65: this record's comparison keeps the rest fixed; with the rest responding through its registration, the comparison is decided within the part's responsive reach, which holds what the part reaches (Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response, comparison-where-the-rest-responds). The response premise is supplied; next_delta revised; see §{S_RESPONSE} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

next_delta_read.zh: 对每个世界的确切重述是本记录的 Flow.withheld_at、supported_of_net_give_at、admits_of_net_draw_at、supported_iff_within_margin_at（P50），局部条件写在规律之内：只在该形成所需的条件上、t 之前各步平衡（Flow.BalancesOn）；边界仍是确切的当且仅当；Flow.Balances.withheld、supported_of_net_give、admits_of_net_draw、supported_iff_within_margin是它们的推论；让其余者随之调整的反事实（扣留后其余者的取用随水平而变）；多步可达的比较；与 Becoming.Joint 的 but-for 检验的形式联系。
next_delta_read.en: The exact restatement for every world is this record's Flow.withheld_at, supported_of_net_give_at, admits_of_net_draw_at, supported_iff_within_margin_at (P50), the local condition inside the law: balance only at the conditions the formation requires, across the steps before t (Flow.BalancesOn); the boundary stays an exact iff; Flow.Balances.withheld, supported_of_net_give, admits_of_net_draw, supported_iff_within_margin are their corollaries; a counterfactual in which the rest adjust (the others' taking responding to the levels without the part); comparison of reachability over several steps; a formal link to the but-for test of Becoming.Joint.

next_delta.zh: 对每个世界的确切重述是本记录的 Flow.withheld_at、supported_of_net_give_at、admits_of_net_draw_at、supported_iff_within_margin_at（P50），局部条件写在规律之内：只在该形成所需的条件上、t 之前各步平衡（Flow.BalancesOn）；边界仍是确切的当且仅当；Flow.Balances.withheld、supported_of_net_give、admits_of_net_draw、supported_iff_within_margin是它们的推论；其余者随之调整时的余量（扣留后其余者的取用随水平而变；P65 给出其余经其识回应时差别所能到达之处，见 comparison-where-the-rest-responds，这样回应之下的确切余量仍开放）；多步可达的比较；与 Becoming.Joint 的 but-for 检验的形式联系。
next_delta.en: The exact restatement for every world is this record's Flow.withheld_at, supported_of_net_give_at, admits_of_net_draw_at, supported_iff_within_margin_at (P50), the local condition inside the law: balance only at the conditions the formation requires, across the steps before t (Flow.BalancesOn); the boundary stays an exact iff; Flow.Balances.withheld, supported_of_net_give, admits_of_net_draw, supported_iff_within_margin are their corollaries; the margin where the rest adjust (the others' taking responding to the levels without the part; P65 states where the difference can go when the rest responds through its registration, comparison-where-the-rest-responds, and the exact margin under such a response is open); comparison of reachability over several steps; a formal link to the but-for test of Becoming.Joint.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P65：两个开端相同的流之间，其余经其识回应时，差别到不了部分的回应所及之外（Flow.not_differs_beyond_response，comparison-where-the-rest-responds）；这样回应之下的余量没有陈述；next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_RESPONSE}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P65: between two flows starting alike, with the rest responding through its registration, the difference reaches nothing beyond the part's responsive reach (Flow.not_differs_beyond_response, comparison-where-the-rest-responds); the margin under such a response is not stated; next_delta revised; see §{S_RESPONSE} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

next_delta_read.zh: 多步 Scope 的桥：感知只经识的策略在识得相同的流上有同样的所见范围；实验：变动自己的动作并识差别；模型从哪里来；由动力学给出回应，而不是假设它；识关于什么（校准）。
next_delta_read.en: The multi-step Scope bridge: a policy sensing only through registration has the same visible scope on flows registered alike; experiment: varying one's own act and registering the difference; where a model comes from; responses given by the dynamics rather than assumed; what a registration is about (calibration).

next_delta.zh: 多步 Scope 的桥：感知只经识的策略在识得相同的流上有同样的所见范围；实验：变动自己的动作并识差别；模型从哪里来（P66 给出哪些投影承载模型：恰是投影相同的配置同去者，见 projection-carrying-a-law）；由动力学给出回应，而不是另给它（P65 另给其余经其识回应，并把比较定在回应所及之内）；识关于什么（校准）。
next_delta.en: The multi-step Scope bridge: a policy sensing only through registration has the same visible scope on flows registered alike; experiment: varying one's own act and registering the difference; where a model comes from (P66 states which projections carry one: exactly those under which configurations alike go alike, projection-carrying-a-law); responses given by the dynamics rather than supplied (P65 supplies that the rest responds through its registration and decides the comparison within the responsive reach); what a registration is about (calibration).

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P64、P65、P66：经选择者之识直到某步的每个选择（本记录的信念是其一）恰在选择者把两段历史识得相同时选它们相同（Web.selects_alike_iff，selection-through-registration）；其余经其识回应时，比较在回应所及之内决定，是本记录 Flow.alike_within_closed 从部分一方的对偶（comparison-where-the-rest-responds）；投影恰在投影相同的配置同去时承载规律（projection-carrying-a-law）。next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_SELECTION}、§{S_RESPONSE}、§{S_MECHANISM}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P64, P65, P66: every selection through a selector's registration up to a step, this record's belief among them, selects two histories alike exactly when the selector registers them alike (Web.selects_alike_iff, selection-through-registration); with the rest responding through its registration, the comparison is decided within the responsive reach, the dual from a part's side of this record's Flow.alike_within_closed (comparison-where-the-rest-responds); a projection carries a law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike (projection-carrying-a-law). next_delta revised; see §{S_SELECTION}, §{S_RESPONSE} and §{S_MECHANISM} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

next_delta_read.zh: 以 Becoming.Testing 的识为投影的形式桥接：经所识者的实验何时是对的；动作与隐藏者的何种相关使模型永不被否证的一般形式；不确定过程中的实验。
next_delta_read.en: The formal bridge with Becoming.Testing's registration as the projection: when an experiment through what registers is right; the general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model unrefuted; experiment in undetermined processes.

next_delta.zh: 以 Becoming.Testing 的识为投影的形式桥接（对任一投影，P66 给出条件：恰在投影相同的配置同去时，有确定过程经它容许如此读的每一步，carries_law_iff）；动作与隐藏者的何种相关使模型永不被否证的一般形式；动作中被遗忘的部分造成差别时的实验（P68：遗忘噪声后，标准模型恰在噪声不造成差别时确定，forget_inputs_determined_iff）。
next_delta.en: The formal bridge with Becoming.Testing's registration as the projection (for any projection P66 states the condition: some determined process through it admits every step so read exactly where configurations alike under it go alike, carries_law_iff); the general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model unrefuted; experiment where a forgotten part of the move makes a difference (P68: with the noise forgotten, the standard model is determined exactly where the noise makes no difference, forget_inputs_determined_iff).

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P66、P68：投影恰在投影相同的配置同去时承载确定的模型（carries_law_iff），这样的规律在运行未取之处也不被固定（Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike），见 projection-carrying-a-law；标准模型 x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t) 中，干预是未取的动作，噪声是未表示的动作（causal-models-as-processes）。next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_MECHANISM}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P66, P68: a projection carries a determined model exactly where configurations alike under it go alike (carries_law_iff), and such a law is not fixed where the run has not taken it either (Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike), projection-carrying-a-law; in the standard model x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t) an intervention is a move not taken and noise a move not represented (causal-models-as-processes). next_delta revised; see §{S_MECHANISM} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

next_delta_read.zh: 定义回路（水平影响取用、取用又影响水平的闭合）并把失控本身陈述为定理；他者回应储量时的策略形式；带误差的量度。
next_delta_read.en: Define a loop (levels affecting taking, and taking the levels) and state a runaway itself as a theorem; the policy form where others respond to the stock; measurement with error.

next_delta.zh: 一般地定义回路（水平影响取用、取用又影响水平的闭合；P65 的 Loop 是一个见证：部分的动作改变另一形成所识，另一形成回应，差别回到部分的支持）并把失控本身陈述为定理；他者回应储量时的策略形式；带误差的量度。
next_delta.en: Define a loop in general (levels affecting taking, and taking the levels; P65's Loop is one witness, in which a part's act changes what another formation registers, the other responds, and the difference returns to the part's support) and state a runaway itself as a theorem; the policy form where others respond to the stock; measurement with error.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P64、P65：经识的选择分不出所及超出与不超出而抬高所识者，并在所及超出抬高所识者时偏向它（Diversion.favours、Diversion.blind_to_source，selection-through-registration）；一个回路的见证：差别经另一形成的回应回到部分（Loop.returns，comparison-where-the-rest-responds）。next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S_SELECTION}、§{S_RESPONSE}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P64, P65: a selection through registration cannot tell reaching beyond from raising what registers without it, and favours reaching beyond where it raises what registers (Diversion.favours, Diversion.blind_to_source, selection-through-registration); a witness of a loop in which the difference returns to the part through another's response (Loop.returns, comparison-where-the-rest-responds). next_delta revised; see §{S_SELECTION} and §{S_RESPONSE} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P66：Law.reform_reabsorbed 改为 Becoming.Mechanism 的 Law.reabsorbed 以 π = Prod.snd（规则）为投影的实例，一行证明；名称与陈述不变，Becoming.Capture 导入 Becoming.Mechanism（整合者的决定：一条定理，不是两条）；见整合文档 §{S_MECHANISM}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P66: Law.reform_reabsorbed re-proved as the instance of Law.reabsorbed (Becoming.Mechanism) with π = Prod.snd, the rule; name and statement unchanged, Becoming.Capture importing Becoming.Mechanism (the integrator's decision: one theorem, not two); see §{S_MECHANISM} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.
